scope: Depositor processing for the snRNA-seq matrix used by HypoExplorer; not the separate Stereo-seq assay.

source.source_identity: Author-uploaded full paper, credited to coauthor Qing-Feng Wu, uploaded 2024-02-14.
source.location: STAR Methods, snRNA-seq quality control, page e4; key resources table, page e1.
source.excerpt: STAR v2.5.3 was applied for reads alignment with the Macaca_fascicularis_5.0 genome.
source.retention: This file is a source review and short excerpt, not a downloaded publisher response. Its upstream-table SHA-256 pins these review bytes. Publisher and direct ResearchGate downloads returned HTTP 403; the author's full-text rendering was readable through web retrieval.

findings.preprocessing: PISA 0.7 is specified for filtering and demultiplexing.
findings.annotation: The snRNA-seq methods do not identify an annotation provider, GTF/GFF file or release.
findings.quantifier: The snRNA-seq methods do not identify the counting tool. PISA is not assigned this role without evidence. SAW 4.1.0 is described for Stereo-seq, not snRNA-seq.

author_code.review: All 24 repository files were inspected for reference/annotation and input-loading terms. Analyses load processed RDS/H5AD objects; the audit found no upstream annotation release or read-counting command. The audit hashes UTF-8 encoded decoded response text and retains the matched lines; it does not retain full source files.

remaining_unknowns: Annotation provider and release for the pre-mRNA reference
next_evidence: A depositor reference manifest, GTF/GFF filename and version, or the raw-read processing commands would resolve the remaining unknowns. Reviewed means the available sources were checked, not that unstated details were recovered.
